annotations.text:
Big number leads, one split bar underneath — teal savings, amber investments, against both targets added together.
The month-end card below it is the motivator: the far-off target divided by the months left gives a figure for THIS month,
and the bar fills as you close the gap. Derived, never typed in — it moves when the target or the months left move.

The + button floats over every tab. Tap it and this sheet slides up.
Three numbers and you are done — the Log tab is gone, history moved to its own tab.

No account, no backend, no analytics. Data is written to IndexedDB on the device.
Two CSV exports feed a Google Sheet by hand each month — entries on one tab, summary on the other.
A JSON backup is the route to a new phone. Nothing syncs on its own.
